name: Cua mat trang
summary: A crab Báo Đồng Nai says carries red spots on the shell like a moon. Locals told Báo Đồng Nai the meat is best in the week of the rising moon: sweet, firm, and richer in minerals than other crabs. Shells are also used as decoration. No price was printed.
origin: Côn Đảo. Báo Đồng Nai, 11 July 2025.
taste: Báo Đồng Nai says the meat is sweet and firm in the week of the rising moon, and richer in minerals than other crabs.
howToEat: Order it as a seafood plate. A recipe was not printed.
Báo Điện Biên Phủ, 31 July 2026, says moon crab is on seaside restaurant menus. The night-market report cooks crab to order, but the crab in that meal was ghẹ, not this species.
